$comment: Publisher namespaces we have claimed on the Adze gallery.
recommended by the generated product.json against this list and fails the
build on a miss. ADR-0009 explains why that is a build gate rather than a
report: a recommendation for an unclaimed namespace on a self-hosted
registry is an invitation for anyone to register it and ship an update to
users whose editor told them to install it.
The list is short on purpose. A namespace belongs here once it is actually
claimed on the gallery - not once someone intends to claim it. Adding a
namespace here to make a red build go green re-opens exactly the
vulnerability the gate exists to close.
Nothing is claimed yet in the sense that matters, because no gallery has
been deployed. `adze` is listed because it is our own publisher id and the
namespace is reserved by construction on any instance we operate.
